description: x402-hyperliquid-mids: Every Hyperliquid mid price in one call — the cheapest way to price a whole portfolio or screen the exchange. Returns plain perp coins (BTC, ETH, ...) and, separately, Hyperliquid's numbered outcome markets (keys like "#12090"), which are its on-chain prediction markets. Optional case-insensitive substring filter, e.g. {"filter":"sol"}.
